_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with F&G ~51 and mild drift sits at the Anxiety/Complacency boundary; base rate favors HOLD until extremes actually break price.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst explicitly HOLD toward Complacency; Narrative gives no forward phase/direction (commodity tape only)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-58, 30d momentum stays drift-like (-8% to +5%), ETF flows dead without a price break
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 40 with accelerating downside (stay/revisit Anxiety) or ETF flows rebound and F&G clears 62 (Disbelief)
